   - NHPs share a closer evolutionary lineage with humans than other commonly used animal models (e.g., rodents).    - Some diseases and experimental treatments are species-specific or require a level of neural complexity only found in primates. - The scientific community is actively working to develop and validate alternative models that better mimic human biology while minimizing ethical concerns.
